purpose: Authorize the server-side secret boundary used to derive ENT-CREDENTIAL valueHash without changing the existing persistence schema.

bindingRules.purposeRestrictedTo: AUTH-003 ENT-CREDENTIAL valueHash derivation and verification

rotation.retirementCondition: All existing credential hashes are either re-derived with ACTIVE during authorized verification/update or the previous key is otherwise proven unused before removal.

nonGoals: No new D1 table or column
No secret material committed to source control
No new Worker, Queue or D1
Better Auth password hashing is the active credential hashing authority; AUTH003_CREDENTIAL_HASH_KEY is not an active authentication authority.
supersessionReason: Current authentication authority is Better Auth 1.7.7 in W02/D1-01; this contract described the retired custom credential-hash or credential-entity implementation.
